feedback.omission: I couldn’t make out the word “{word}” — was it skipped or said differently?
feedback.omission.tip: Say every word, nice and steady — don’t rush to the end.
feedback.insertion.tip: Say just the words on the screen.
feedback.fine.tip: Keep saying it just like that!
feedback.word.tip: Tap Slow, listen to each part of the word, then say it just as slowly.
feedback.sound.heard.tappedR.kid: Your “{sound}” sounded like a quick tapped R.
feedback.sound.heard.tappedR.adult: Your /{sound}/ sounded like a quick tapped R.
feedback.sound.heard.throatyR.kid: Your “{sound}” sounded like a throaty R.
feedback.sound.heard.throatyR.adult: Your /{sound}/ sounded like a throaty R.
feedback.sound.heard.throatyH.kid: Your “{sound}” sounded like a throaty, scratchy H.
feedback.sound.heard.throatyH.adult: Your /{sound}/ sounded like a throaty, scratchy H.
feedback.sound.likely.little: Your “{sound}” wasn’t clear. Careful — it likes to turn into “{other}”!
feedback.sound.likely.kid: Your “{sound}” wasn’t clear. Careful — it easily turns into “{other}”.
feedback.sound.likely.adult: Your /{sound}/ wasn’t clear. Careful — it easily turns into /{other}/.
feedback.sound.likelyMissing.kid: Your “{sound}” wasn’t clear — make sure it doesn’t disappear.
feedback.sound.likelyMissing.adult: Your /{sound}/ wasn’t clear — make sure it doesn’t disappear.
feedback.zh.omission: I couldn’t make out “{char}” ({pinyin}) — was it skipped or said differently?
feedback.zh.omission.tip: Say every character, nice and steady — don’t rush to the end.
feedback.zh.tone.little.1.1: “{char}” stays high and flat — yours stayed flat!
feedback.zh.tone.little.1.2: “{char}” stays high and flat — yours went up!
feedback.zh.tone.little.1.3: “{char}” stays high and flat — yours went down low!
feedback.zh.tone.little.1.4: “{char}” stays high and flat — yours fell!
feedback.zh.tone.little.3.1: “{char}” dips down low — yours stayed flat!
feedback.zh.tone.little.3.2: “{char}” dips down low — yours went up!
feedback.zh.tone.little.3.3: “{char}” dips down low — yours went down low!
feedback.zh.tone.little.4.1: “{char}” falls from high to low — yours stayed flat!
feedback.zh.tone.little.4.2: “{char}” falls from high to low — yours went up!
feedback.zh.tone.little.4.3: “{char}” falls from high to low — yours went down low!
feedback.zh.tone.little.4.4: “{char}” falls from high to low — yours fell!
feedback.zh.tone.needs.1: It needs tone 1: it stays high and flat.
feedback.zh.tone.needs.3: It needs tone 3: it dips down low.
feedback.zh.tone.needs.4: It needs tone 4: it falls from high to low.
feedback.zh.sandhi.third: Here {char} is said with tone 2, because the word after it is tone 3.
feedback.zh.sandhi.yi.1: 一 changes its tone to match the word after it — here it’s tone 1.
feedback.zh.sandhi.yi.2: 一 changes its tone to match the word after it — here it’s tone 2.
feedback.zh.sandhi.yi.3: 一 changes its tone to match the word after it — here it’s tone 3.
feedback.zh.sandhi.yi.4: 一 changes its tone to match the word after it — here it’s tone 4.
feedback.zh.sandhi.bu: 不 becomes tone 2 before a tone-4 word.
feedback.zh.heard.tip: Listen slowly, then copy every part of the sound.
feedback.zh.word.tip: Tap Slow, listen to the whole sound, then copy it.
feedback.zh.sound.mixup: Careful — {label} is easy to mix up.
feedback.headline.okay: Nearly there — one thing to fix.
feedback.headline.weak: Good effort. Let’s fix one sound.
feedback.headline.hard: That’s a tricky one. Listen slowly, then try again.
